system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve or 1 Wound

Range: Self

Area: 5-space radius, 5-space-line

You create Black Flame within objects themselves, using it to disintegrate trees, shatter buildings, and rend the ground beneath your feet.

As an Action, choose one of the following effects:

  • Disintegrate

    • Choose a large or smaller non-magical object within 10 spaces. A burst of Black Flame burns it away.

    • This can clear obstacles from your path and remove the Difficult Terrain or Cover traits from an area within a 5-space-radius.

  • Break

    • Choose a solid structure within 10 spaces, such as a wall or cliffside. The structure crumbles as Black Flame erupts from the cracks.

    • This can affect a number of contiguous spaces equal to 2 * your Training in Metaphysics (minimum of 2).

    • This can be used to destroy buildings, carve tunnels, or give an area the Difficult Terrain trait within a 5-space-radius.

  • Rend

    • Draw a 5-space-line starting at any point within 10 spaces of you, with no space currently occupied by a creature. Black Flame erupts from a rend in the earth, splitting the ground in two.

    • Moving across the line requires an Action to jump across the gap.

    • The line can take whatever shape you like, so long as it does not cross over itself.

    • The gap is 1 space wide, and 10 spaces deep.
